script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling the wilderness an empty stretch adds a detail the text does not give.
Saying the glory's revelation is the whole reason for the road work adds a purpose the passage does not state.
The passage contrasts God's enduring word with flesh and its glory; it does not say everything else fades.
The claim that everything else fades goes beyond the passage's comparison with flesh and its glory.
The verse says God's word stands forever, not that it is still speaking or never goes quiet.
The text tells the herald what to say; it does not say the herald delivers the message.
The text instructs the herald to speak to the cities; it does not report that the herald says the message.
The rolling pin and gardening joke has no clear connection to the comparison or the answer, so it does not pass the joke logic test.
Gently leading the nursing ewes does not establish that there is no hurrying them along.
